title: Mobile Suit Gundam Side Story III: Sabakareshi Mono
native_title: 機動戦士ガンダム外伝Ⅲ ～裁かれし者～
overview:
The final chapter of the Blue Destiny story. Zeon ace Nimbus Schterzen has stolen the EXAM-equipped Blue Destiny Unit 2, and Yuu Kajima's experimental squad is ordered to get it back. Handed Blue Destiny Unit 3, the last remaining EXAM machine, the team pursues him as the battle moves from Earth into space.

Fight from a first-person cockpit view through five missions in this 3D shooting game. With few space-capable mobile suits on hand, some missions put you in whatever machine the squad can field. Each mission is graded on your performance, and top marks earn Yuu promotions. Rank carried over from the earlier chapters through saved data shapes the ending.

- Multiple endings
- Twin Stick compatible
- Memory backup support
